About the TrailBlaze X1

The X1 is our best-selling multi-day pack, engineered for week-long traverses and heavy loads. The adjustable AntiGravity suspension transfers up to 85% of pack weight to your hips, while the suspended mesh back panel keeps a channel of air moving between you and the load.

Key specifications

TrailBlaze X1 45L technical specifications
Capacity45 liters (expandable to 50)
Weight3 lb 6 oz (1.53 kg)
Fabric210D ripstop nylon, DWR finish
FrameRemovable aluminum perimeter frame
Rain coverIncluded, stows in base pocket
WarrantyLifetime, transferable

Features

  • U-shaped zip opening for clamshell access to the main compartment
  • Dual ice-axe loops and trekking pole attachment
  • Hydration sleeve fits up to a 3L reservoir
  • Eight external pockets including two hip-belt pockets
